parameters.content: Set THIS workflow as the 'Error Workflow' (Workflow settings) of every other CA workflow. Normalizes, redacts secrets, persists to errors, and raises a deduplicated CRITICAL notification.

parameters.query: WITH e AS (INSERT INTO errors(category, severity, retryable, workflow, node, message, details) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::boolean, $4, $5, $6, jsonb_build_object('execution_id', $7::text)) RETURNING id) SELECT ca_notify(CASE WHEN $2 = 'critical' THEN 'CRITICAL' ELSE 'INFO' END, 'error', 'Workflow error: ' || $4 || ' / ' || COALESCE($5,'?') || ' (' || $1 || ')', $6, 'err:' || $4 || ':' || COALESCE($5,'') || ':' || $1 || ':' || to_char(now(),'YYYYMMDDHH24'), NULL, NULL) FROM e

meta.note: Credentials are NOT embedded. After import, open each node showing a credential warning and select your own credential (see SETUP.md).
